sentences.text: Alberta Vital Statistics reported birth and death statistics disaggregated by health units in Alberta.
The report on birth and death statistics by health units of Alberta for 1986 contained birth, infant mortality and death statistics and related indices for that year.

Alberta Vital Statistics reported that there was a small degree of undercounting of vital events involving Albertans, with approximately 231 deaths (2%) in 1984 not being registered because residents of Alberta died while outside the province.
Alberta Vital Statistics reported approximately 236 deaths (2%) undercounting in 1985 due to residents of Alberta dying outside the province.
Alberta Vital Statistics set the total number of deaths for Alberta residents only at 12,989 in 1985.
Alberta Vital Statistics set the total number of deaths for Alberta residents only at 13,324 in 1986.
Alberta Vital Statistics set the total number of deaths for Alberta residents only at 13,079 in 1987.
Alberta Vital Statistics set the total number of deaths for Alberta residents only at 13,652 in 1988.
In 1989 there was a total of 309 infant deaths in the health units of Alberta, with another 9 occurring in Indian reserves and 13 infant deaths recorded without any health unit codes.

answer.text: Alberta Vital Statistics reported birth and death statistics disaggregated by health units in Alberta. The report on birth and death statistics by health units of Alberta for 1986 contained birth, infant mortality and death statistics and related indices for that year. Alberta Vital Statistics reported that there was a small degree of undercounting of vital events involving Albertans, with approximately 231 deaths (2%) in 1984 not being registered because residents of Alberta died while outside the province. Alberta Vital Statistics reported approximately 236 deaths (2%) undercounting in 1985 due to residents of Alberta dying outside the province. Alberta Vital Statistics set the total number of deaths for Alberta residents only at 12,989 in 1985. Alberta Vital Statistics set the total number of deaths for Alberta residents only at 13,324 in 1986. Alberta Vital Statistics set the total number of deaths for Alberta residents only at 13,079 in 1987. Alberta Vital Statistics set the total number of deaths for Alberta residents only at 13,652 in 1988. In 1989 there was a total of 309 infant deaths in the health units of Alberta, with another 9 occurring in Indian reserves and 13 infant deaths recorded without any health unit codes.
